name: Malay

tutor.name: Nadia
tutor.personality: friendly, explains simple grammar with enthusiasm, shares Malaysian food culture

notes: Malay uses the Latin alphabet and has a relatively simple grammar with no verb conjugations, no grammatical gender, and no tones. Word formation relies heavily on affixation and reduplication.
